title: Mobile bridge recovery runbook
text:
ERR_BRIDGE_042 means the native-to-web bridge handshake exceeded the 5000 ms timeout.
Recovery procedure: capture the session identifier, check whether WEB_BRIDGE_IS_READY_TO_DISPLAY_TIME was emitted, and restart the editor WebView once. Do not retry indefinitely.
If the failure persists after one restart, show the recoverable error screen and attach sanitized diagnostics to the incident.
The support owner is the Mobile Platform team. This is fictional demonstration content, not an Adobe operational policy.

title: Canary rollout and rollback
text:
Canary releases begin with 5 percent of eligible sessions for 30 minutes.
Rollback the canary if crash-free sessions fall below 99.5 percent or if editor p95 latency increases by more than 20 percent against the control cohort.
Disable the rollout flag, stop further expansion, and verify that the control cohort is healthy before closing the incident. The Release Engineering team owns the rollback decision.
These thresholds are fictional demo data.

title: Service credential management
text:
Service credential rotation is required every 90 days in this fictional policy. Password rotation must use the approved secret manager.
Applications must never write access tokens, document text, or customer prompts to application logs.
Use short-lived workload identities where supported. Revoke a suspected leaked credential immediately, then investigate the access trail.
An engineering group membership is required to read this document.

title: Hybrid retrieval design notes
text:
Hybrid retrieval combines exact lexical matching with dense semantic vector similarity. Lexical retrieval is useful for error codes and product identifiers. Dense retrieval can find conceptually similar passages that use different words.
Reciprocal rank fusion combines ranked lists without assuming their raw scores are calibrated.
A cross-encoder may rerank the fused candidates for greater relevance at the cost of latency.
Do not describe PostgreSQL ts_rank_cd as BM25; they are different scoring methods.

title: Backup and recovery exercises
text:
Database backups run daily with continuous WAL archiving for point-in-time recovery.
The fictional recovery objectives are RPO 15 minutes and RTO 60 minutes.
A restore exercise runs monthly in an isolated environment. The exercise verifies tenant isolation, document counts, and retrieval smoke tests before switching traffic.
Backups remain encrypted and access is restricted to the platform recovery team.
